sources.snippet: The model was benchmarked against OpenAI's GPT-2 Small and GPT-3 Small (both ~124M parameters). Remarkably, despite being trained on only 10 billion tokens, compared to GPT-3 Small's 300 billion tokens, GPT-124M was able to outperform both models in HellaSwag evaluation.

sources.title: GPT-2 124M Reproduction | githubaryan5555/nanoGPT | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page provides a complete guide to reproducing OpenAI's GPT-2 124M model on the OpenWebText dataset using nanoGPT. It covers hardware requirements, data preparation, training configuration, launch commands, and expected results. This reproduction achieves a validation loss of approximately 2.85 after training for ~4-5 days on 8×A100 40GB GPUs.
